remarks: Nestled in the heart of Stamford, Connecticut, at 1038 Westover Road, this contemporary colonial home offers 4,262 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. With four spacious bedrooms and three and a half elegant bathrooms, plus a large family room, this home blends classic charm with modern convenience. An expansive, sun-filled family room and open-concept kitchen are perfect for both entertaining and daily life. Additionally, a private in-law suite above the garage provides a comfortable and versatile retreat. Experience refined living in one of Stamford's most sought-after neighborhoods. PLEASE JOIN ME AND TOUR THIS MAGNIFICENT RESIDENCE. A MUST SEE TO APPRECIATE!
